description.value:
You hurl a ball of pulsing violet light harvested from the space between planes. Make a ranged spell attack roll against the target. On a hit, the target takes 4d6 vitality damage. Additionally, on a hit the target must attempt a Fortitude save against your spell DC; on a failure, the planar energy saturates the target, causing it to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Sickened]{Sickened 1} for 1 minute. On a critical failure of the Fortitude save, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Sickened]{Sickened 2}. The target can spend an action to attempt a Fortitude save to reduce the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Sickened]{Sickened} condition by 1 (minimum 0). On a critical hit with the attack roll, the Fortitude save is made at a -2 status penalty.

Heightened (+1) The vitality damage increases by 2d6.
